plugins.name: greenfield
plugins.description: A greenfield delivery methodology: spec-driven engagement gates, client sign-off artifacts, tracker integration, and build standards.

skills.name: architecture-design
skills.description: Use when producing the engagement design document, choosing architecture or stack for a client project, or generating the client repository's CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md. Gate 2 of the greenfield delivery sequence.
headings: Write it from the agreed design, not from the code
skills.description_zh: 作为 greenfield 交付第二关生成客户项目设计文档、选择架构和技术栈，或生成客户仓库 CLAUDE.md 与 AGENTS.md。

skills.name: build-loop
skills.description: Use when actually building - working a task from pick-up to merge with an agent, verifying the result, reviewing agent-written code and tests, and handling what to do when the build shows the specification was wrong. Gate 3 of the greenfield delivery sequence.
headings: Split the criterion before you start
Read for what is missing, not for what is wrong
Conventions are the easiest thing to imitate
Agent-written tests are the highest-risk artifact in the change
When the build shows the specification was wrong
skills.description_zh: 作为交付第三关推进任务从领取到合并，核验代理实现、审查代码测试，并处理构建中发现规格错误的情况。

skills.name: build-standards
skills.description: Use when writing code, tests, or reviews on a client engagement, or when deciding whether work meets the engagement's definition of done. Also the source content for each client repository's CLAUDE.md. Gate 3 of the greenfield delivery sequence.
headings: This is the standard, not the procedure
skills.description_zh: 提供客户项目的编码、测试、审查与完成标准，也作为客户仓库 CLAUDE.md 内容来源，属于交付第三关。

skills.name: business-test-cases
skills.description: Use when turning approved requirements into business test cases a person can execute - writing them, reviewing them, tracking their results, and taking them into handoff acceptance. Authoring and acceptance only; for generating Gherkin, wiring step definitions, or importing runner results, use qe.
headings: Mode is a delivery decision, not a business one
skills.description_zh: 把获批需求写成可由人工执行的业务测试，审查、跟踪结果并纳入交接验收；仅编写与验收，Gherkin 和自动化结果由 qe 处理。

skills.name: discovery
skills.description: Use when scoping a new client engagement before requirements - running a discovery conversation, writing a problem statement, or producing an estimate range. Gate 0 of the greenfield delivery sequence.
headings: First release — explicitly out of scope
skills.description_zh: 作为交付第零关在需求阶段前探索新客户项目范围，开展访谈、写问题定义和估算区间。

skills.name: greenfield-delivery
skills.description: Use when working on a client greenfield engagement - starting one, moving through a delivery gate, writing requirements or design documents, syncing work to a tracker, or handing off. Defines the gate sequence and routes to the right skill for each step.
headings: When asked to skip a gate
skills.description_zh: 定义客户新建项目的交付关卡与技能路由，涵盖启动、需求设计、跟踪器同步和交接。

skills.name: handoff
skills.description: Use when closing out a client engagement - assembling the delivery package, writing the runbook, or producing the engagement record for acceptance. Gate 4 of the greenfield delivery sequence.
skills.description_zh: 作为交付第四关组装客户交付包、运行手册及用于验收的项目记录。

skills.name: progress-reporting
skills.description: Use when writing or updating a client-facing engagement status page for business stakeholders - in Confluence, ADO Wiki, or repository markdown.
skills.description_zh: 在 Confluence、ADO Wiki 或仓库 Markdown 编写更新面向业务利益相关者的客户项目状态页。

skills.name: qe
skills.description: Use when automating test cases that already exist - generating Gherkin feature files from test-cases.md, deciding what should and should not be automated, wiring step definitions in the client repository, and reading run results back into the engagement record. Automation only; the test cases themselves are written in business-test-cases.
headings: What to automate, and what not to
skills.description_zh: 将已有 test-cases.md 自动化为 Gherkin，判断适合自动化的用例、接入步骤定义并把运行结果回写项目记录；用例编写交由 business-test-cases。

skills.name: requirements-gate
skills.description: Use when writing or reviewing engagement requirements and acceptance criteria, or preparing the client sign-off that establishes the scope baseline. Gate 1 of the greenfield delivery sequence.
headings: Why this gate carries the commercial weight
Where requirements come from — and when the gate happens
After the gate: amend, never edit
Write down their words as you hear them
skills.description_zh: 作为交付第一关编写审查需求与验收标准，准备客户签署确认以建立范围基线。

skills.name: tracker-azure-devops
skills.description: Use when the engagement tracker is Azure DevOps and you need the ADO-specific mechanics - creating epics, features, or product backlog items, updating states, or writing ADO Wiki status pages. What makes a work item well-specified in the first place is in tracker-conventions.
headings: Pre-flight — twenty minutes, before you promise anything
MCP setup — local server, per engagement
Use the local server. The remote one cannot work here.
Config goes in the client project, not this plugin
skills.description_zh: 在 Azure DevOps 创建 epic、feature、产品积压项，更新状态并写 ADO Wiki 状态页；工作项规范由 tracker-conventions 定义。

skills.name: tracker-conventions
skills.description: Use when deciding what belongs in a work item, ticket, story, or backlog item on a client engagement, and whether one is well-specified enough to assign to an agent. Tracker-agnostic rules only; for the API calls, issue types, and field names of a specific tool, use tracker-jira or tracker-azure-devops.
headings: Why this matters more than it looks
Ready to assign to an agent
skills.description_zh: 制定与工具无关的客户项目工作项、票据和故事内容规则，判断是否明确到可以分派代理；Jira/ADO API 字段与操作交由专用技能。

skills.name: tracker-jira
skills.description: Use when the engagement tracker is Jira and you need the Jira-specific mechanics - creating epics, stories, or issues, updating status, writing Confluence status pages, or assigning work to Claude Agent for Jira. What makes a work item well-specified in the first place is in tracker-conventions.
headings: Unattended work — Claude Agent for Jira
Handing work over is a UI action, not an API one
MCP setup — hosted server, configured once
Authorize, once per person per machine
Verify before you rely on it
What to do while access is pending
skills.description_zh: 在 Jira 创建 epic、story 和 issue、更新状态、写 Confluence 状态页或分派 Claude Agent for Jira；工作项质量规则交由 tracker-conventions。

commands.name: approve
commands.description: Draft a gate approval request, or record an approval the client has given
headings: 2. Confirm there is something to approve
4. Establish that it is actually an approval
5. Ask for what you cannot know

commands.name: conform
commands.description: Check this engagement's record against the rules the methodology states

commands.name: dashboard
commands.description: Open the read-only engagement dashboard in a browser

commands.name: gate
commands.description: Run a delivery gate end to end - produce the artifact, review it, prepare sign-off, record approval
headings: 3. Review before the client sees it

commands.name: handoff
commands.description: Assemble the engagement delivery package and record for client acceptance
headings: 1. Confirm there is a baseline to verify against

commands.name: import-artifact
commands.description: Bring a document you already have into the engagement as a gate artifact
headings: 1a. The source can be a Confluence page
After the import, `requirements.md` is the baseline — not the page
1b. Is it a document, or a transcript?
2. Read the document as it is

commands.name: new-engagement
commands.description: Start a new client engagement - scaffold the docs, capture tracker and reporting config
headings: 2. Flag the Azure DevOps margin implication
5. Azure DevOps only — write the project `.mcp.json`

commands.name: qe
commands.description: Generate Gherkin feature files from the business test cases, or read run results back

commands.name: status-report
commands.description: Regenerate the client-facing status page for business stakeholders
headings: Stop if the target is not fully specified

commands.name: sync-tracker
commands.description: Sync tasks.md into the engagement tracker and pull status back
headings: Map by status *category*, not by status name
Pull the assignee across with the status
`blocked` and `dropped` are local, and a pull must never erase them
Two people may sync at once
How a requirement becomes a ticket
What is verified, and what is not
